constraints.constraint: P and PN keep identical partition and physical design; runtime N enable differs. Do not replace P with a different compile-time NonblockEnable=0 gate.

One normal TL lifecycle and one N slot. Normal TL releases on accepted slow response; each bank head releases at downstream AW/AR handshake, not B/job completion. Ordinary P may overlap subsequent translations with earlier payload service.
N start needs active S1-only owner walk and another-bank candidate, with exclusions. Window gates only start; no requirement that walk remain active through acceptance or OUT.

Ordered DC then LEAF probes occupy real shared lookup ports and take nonzero state transitions; main lookup hits are masked during corresponding N use. Only accepted probe touches caches. OUT blocks a new normal request; rejected probe does not handshake or continuously retry.

Accepted candidate must be stable; actual cached DC and DDTP stable; DC and 4KiB leaf valid, U and direction-specific R/W permission, S1 Sv39/S2 Bare, canonical, no excluded PID/priv/debug/ATS/PRI/MSI request. Unsupported/miss uses ordinary path.

Accepted TL request is not accepted response, downstream AW, W progress, B, or provider/consumer completion. Preserve single RR fast/slow response, per-bank routing, finite capacity, AW-before-AR head selection and W ownership/data availability.
Public RR/held-valid arbitration applies; no uncharged PN priority, new port, queue depth or cancellation of held candidate. All owner PTE/payload completion and quiet costs count.

One-way ordinary device-to-host write is N-action eligible at the AW/CTL interface without COPY fullbuffer read certificate; AW still needs resources, valid translation/permissions, W ownership, real payload availability and completion. No write-only fixture or actual producer has been established here.

Existing M0 read mem_q is head-serial but AW/W/B have independent queues and readiness. A unified nonpreemptive read/write service server, write delaying PTE reads, real-DRAM coupling, setup-overlap rule or provider write producer must be declared separately.

All service durations, cache/source histories and payload readiness/dependencies are uncalibrated model inputs; require nonzero N/ordinary response and downstream costs and common values across actions. A fixed residual walk hides early-payload/PTE feedback unless explicitly excluded by the chosen projection.

ordinary_baseline_opportunities: After normal slow response is consumed, ordinary P translates next selected bank even while old owner payload/B remains in flight.

Use the same known candidate readiness, cache/partition preparation, publicly available launch/issue controls, and finite outstanding credits; all preparation/control costs and held VALID commitments count.

Permit legal issue/reordering before VALID is committed and ordinary downstream arbitration when the public interface enables it. Do not invent a new P private cache hit classifier or override the physical RR arbiter.

Separate same RTL runtime-P comparison from equal-total-resource architecture comparison. Charge N slot/logic/probe occupancy; any baseline reuse of extra storage requires a concrete implementable interface/control, not a paper-only arbitrary program.
acceptance_boundary: Supports a source-bound conditional principle model with declared projection/assumptions; does not require prior native implementation or measured sign. RTL-equivalent label requires explicit timing/arbitration/capacity/cache/PTE feedback refinement beyond generic event costs.
